relationships.subject: Octreotide
relationships.evidence_quote: it also restored the levels of H2S, CBS, CSE, BDNF, Nrf2 and decreased TNF-α levels

key_findings: Octreotide attenuated alcohol-induced neuropathic pain and restored H2S, CBS, CSE, BDNF and Nrf2 while decreasing TNF-alpha in the sciatic nerve.
The BDNF receptor blocker ANA-12 abolished octreotide effects on pain, TNF-alpha, BDNF and Nrf2 but not H2S.
